# Effort Review

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A structured retrospective evaluating an effort.

## Scope note

- Output of the Effort Review workflow: assesses the actual Effort Log against the Effort Plan intentions.
- Includes Plus-Minus-Next (PMN) analysis by Claude AI: what worked, what needs improving, and what's next.
